theorem eventually_original_medium_signed
    (K modeOrder : ℕ) (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A)
    {kap zeta kappa kap0 : ℝ}
    (hkap : kap < 1)
    (hz : 0 < zeta)
    (hz0 : zeta ≤ 1 / 20000)
    (hk : 0 < kappa)
    (hkz : kappa ≤ zeta / 200000)
    (ht : kap0 < kappa / (4 * (1 + kappa)))
    (ht1 : kap0 < 1) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
        ∀ I : Index modeOrder kap zeta kap0,
          I.P.N = N →
          0 < I.P.e →
          (I.P.e : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2048 →
          0 < I.P.q →
          zeta ≤ localE I.P / 512 →
          logPrimeMeshStep 0 (19 / 96) (d I.P).m ≤
            (I.P.e : ℝ) / 20 →
          0 < I.P.omega →
          zeta ≤ gap I.P.m (d I.P) →
          I.P.T * ((J0 I.P.omega : ℝ) + 1) ≤ zeta →
          0 ≤ I.P.ell →
          2 * I.P.ell ≤ zeta / 16 →
          ∀ D ∈ I.firstOwners,
          ∀ E ∈ I.secondOwners,
          ∀ G ∈ I.thirdOwners,
            ‖(I.atom K D E G).signedError‖ ≤
              C * I.x / (Real.log I.x) ^ A

end
end ImbalancedChen.P1OriginalSingletonMediumSigned
